source_pins.fact: MeshGL is single precision, MeshGL64 is double precision, and core vector/matrix geometry uses double.
MeshGLP is a triangle-mesh interchange structure; polygonal faces are planar within output tolerance; mesh tolerance may collapse edges shorter than tolerance and may grow with floating-point error.
Manifold's internal representation is an oriented 2-manifold triangle mesh; MeshGL/MeshGL64 are its mesh I/O, while LevelSet is a separate constructor.

falsification.hypothesis: A finite floating triangle-mesh Boolean provider can be the sole authoritative MC-1 material representation and engineering-output source for every admitted operation when fed independently qualified actual cutter sweeps.
falsification.criterion: Falsified if a required source-faithful material distinction cannot be represented as exact authoritative truth by the finite triangle/tolerance state without an external certified relation or if the candidate cannot by itself satisfy the conventional primary engineering-output contract.
decisive_observations: MC-019 contains an exact curved ball-end sweep boundary; the rational 3-4-5 witness lies on the exact spherical nose but not on the straight chord between exact endpoint samples, so a finite planar faceting is approximation rather than identical material authority.

The upstream candidate's own mesh contract permits simplification-driven collapse below tolerance and tolerance growth with floating-point error, while MC-1 forbids deleting positive material merely because it is small.
Exact-zero tangency and signed one-millionth neighbours are non-compensating semantics; epsilon-valid/manifold mesh status cannot itself decide which material event occurred.
A manifold triangle mesh and successful mesh Boolean do not constitute conventional analytic/grouped STEP qualification; MC-016 output blockers remain independent.

requirements: independently qualified source-faithful sweep construction remains authoritative
a separate exact or outward-certified material relation/error envelope owns correctness
positive-volume and exact-zero distinctions are checked outside mesh tolerance heuristics
durable body identity and lineage remain journal-owned rather than mesh-component-owned
mesh results are not promoted to primary STEP or independent-consumer qualification
uncertified, resource-refused or tolerance-ambiguous cases fail closed and dispatch non-cyclically

blockers.reason: no universal exact source codec for every admitted arbitrary form/undercut cutter instance
durable multi-body mapping and independent engineering-output preservation remain unqualified
native STEP preservation of certified positive micro-material remains unqualified
exact-zero/touching/singular engineering output remains unqualified without healing or fusion

protected_semantics: canonical operation journal remains durable authority
positive-volume material may not be erased by tolerance
durable body identity and lineage may not be inferred from mesh components or enumeration
STEP remains mandatory primary engineering output; mesh-wrapped STEP is not success
